<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="ranged-nex-bolg" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Ranged Nex (BoLG)</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/EHBFVhLaE2.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>When Nex spawns for the first time in an instance she will be praying </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for the majority of the kill, making Ranged the meta for fast consistent kills. After every kill you will teleport out of the instance and re-enter in order to force Nex to always be praying </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: It is strongly advised to complete the </nowiki></em><em><nowiki>Ritual of the Mahjarrat</nowiki></em><em><nowiki> quest in order to get access to the Stone of Jas </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1" alt="jasboost" title="jasboost" kind="icon" /><nowiki> boost, which gives a +5% damage boost in GWD1 (including Nex). This can be done via Fairy ring code D.K.Q.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=271ab9d3-3a6f-4c5f-bc03-e3fadd435b2e <nowiki>Ranged Nex (BoLG)</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F271ab9d3-3a6f-4c5f-bc03-e3fadd435b2e.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1" alt="mob" title="mob" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should be combo'd with either </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1" alt="biting4" title="biting4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478090603026710648.png?v=1" alt="ultimatums4" title="ultimatums4" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502339891331093.png?v=1" alt="as1" title="as1" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is not recommended with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1" alt="p6" title="p6" kind="icon" /><nowiki> here as it can proc on the Umbra phase transition and null the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hit.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Due to this, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1" alt="p6" title="p6" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800924942396.png?v=1" alt="ruthless1" title="ruthless1" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is recommended instead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
